playerScope: Default player, unsaved values named SP.Shader.Player.%uuid.*

SP.Shader.Sky.Time.behavior: Floor after wrapping into 0 through 23999, default noon at 6000

SP.Shader.Recoil.behavior: Restart the current visual kick, clamp each axis to -8 through 8 degrees, then return over four ticks

particleProtocol.red: Ticks Since Startup modulo 128, shared by all four channel particles
particleProtocol.angleEncoding: Negative degrees use 128 + degrees * 16, nonnegative degrees use 128 + degrees * 15.875. Round to nearest byte.
particleProtocol.markers: One particle per channel each tick, no spread or motion/color variation, opacity zero
particleProtocol.staleMarkerHandling: Each channel and sequence maps to its own shader pixel. The data pass selects the newest cyclic sequence. No unsupported particle lifetime request is sent.

integration.heartbeat: SP.Shader.Tick runs after the three existing markers in shader tick
integration.initializer: SP.Shader.Init resets only this feature's per-player variables inside shaders load
